creator: Olivier Acuna
title: Bermuda, the small island nation with huge crypto ambitions
dc:creator: Olivier Acuna
content: The government recently announced it would become the world’s first economy to go fully onchain, a move officials believe will bring its people new opportunities.

creator: Margaux Nijkerk
title: Coinbase’s Base launches AI tool for ChatGPT to manage crypto wallets and DeFi apps
dc:creator: Margaux Nijkerk
content: The product, called Base MCP, connects a user’s Base Account to AI clients such as ChatGPT, Claude and Cursor using the Model Context Protocol (MCP), an emerging standard that allows AI systems to securely interface with external tools and applications.

creator: Shaurya Malwa
title: XRPL could close its biggest DeFi gap if new AMM amendment passes
dc:creator: Shaurya Malwa
content: A draft proposal filed Tuesday would extend the XRP Ledger's native automated market maker with three swappable curve types, giving liquidity providers more efficient ways to deploy capital and closing one of XRPL DeFi's longest-standing gaps.

creator: Robin Singh
title: The Clarity Act won’t lead to adoption without crypto tax reform
dc:creator: Robin Singh
content: The legislation is being framed as a turning point for U.S. crypto policy, but there’s a major piece of the puzzle being overlooked, argues Singh.

creator: Krisztian Sandor
title: TeraWulf jumps 13% on AI data center expansion in Kentucky
dc:creator: Krisztian Sandor
content: The bitcoin miner turned HPC infrastructure developer unveiled plans for a new 1 gigawatt facility in Kentucky aimed at servicing AI workloads.
